visual_elements.description: Vector-transformation schematic in a green rounded-border container. Left of an orange dashed vertical divider: column vector V₁ = (X₁,X₂,X₃,X₄,X₅,X₆,X₇,X₈,X₉,X₁₀,X₁₁,X₁₂)ᵀ labeled 1xd₁, and shorter column vector V₂ = (X₁,X₂,X₃,X₄,X₅)ᵀ labeled 1xd₂ (label at its bottom-right). Right of the divider: V₁ becomes a column of twelve M's labeled 1xd₁ and V₂ becomes a column of five M's labeled 1xd₂. A white block arrow with blue outline points right at mid-height across the divider. Vector headers V₁/V₂ in blue bold italic; brackets and elements in blue.

Small Gaussian bell-curve plot in a white red-bordered box: light-gray grid, red L-shaped x/y axes with no numeric ticks, gray-blue bell curve centered, blue dashed vertical line through the peak, blue bold-italic label 'M' centered below the x-axis.

Equations box, pale-green fill, red border, four text lines: 'Let Average Values of elements of V₁ = M' / 'Let Average Values of elements of V₂ = M' (black text, V₁/V₂ and M blue bold) and 'Vector Length of V₁ (all Ms) = V₁ᵀ V₁ = M √d₁' / 'Vector Length of V₂ (all Ms) = V₂ᵀ V₂ = M √d₂' (all blue bold italic).
White box, thick green border: '√d is a good choice for scaling' — '√d' large green bold, remainder dark bold italic.
Pale-yellow box, green border: '⁴√d Some times is used' — fourth-root '⁴√d' in green bold, 'Some times is used' in dark bold.
White box, red border: 'd=100, √d =10' in blue bold.
White box, red border: 'SoftMax [w'ᵢⱼ]' — 'SoftMax' red bold, w'ᵢⱼ blue bold italic inside black square brackets.
White box, red border: 'SoftMax' red bold followed by large parentheses containing the fraction w'ᵢⱼ / √d in blue bold italic.

White box, thin red border, five centered lines: 'Remember:' (blue bold italic), '"d" is' (black bold), 'Dimension of Embedding' (red, underlined), 'Not' (blue bold), 'length of input Sequence' (blue italic).

Unscaled-SoftMax flowchart in a black-bordered box. Left node: vertical stack of four tan chips with red borders containing 10, 20, 30, 40, wrapped in large maroon parentheses. Thick red arrow to the right labeled 'SoftMax' (red bold, above arrow). Right node: stack of four white chips with blue borders containing 0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000, 1.0000, wrapped in dark navy parentheses.

Scaled-SoftMax flowchart in a magenta-bordered box with light-pink fill. Chain left→right: stack of tan red-bordered chips 10, 20, 30, 40 in maroon parentheses → large maroon '/' → maroon '( √d )' with big parentheses → thick red arrow labeled 'Scaled' (maroon, above arrow) → stack of tan red-bordered chips 1, 2, 3, 4 in maroon parentheses → thick red arrow labeled 'SoftMax' (maroon, above arrow) → stack of white blue-bordered chips 0.0321, 0.0871, 0.2369, 0.6439 in blue parentheses.
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with red outline containing black '36'.

imagery: No photographs or clip-art anywhere on the slide. The only pictorial element is the small schematic Gaussian bell-curve plot in the top-right box. All other graphics are drawn shapes: bracketed column vectors, parentheses, chip boxes, block arrows, and a dashed divider. A mouse cursor from the screen recording is visible near the bottom-left Remember box (artifact, not slide content).
